feature_catalog.policy: all 54 enabled raw signals plus the 0822 causal engineered features are materialized; training selects a feature subset and one future target

TE8353_history_slope_k_per_min_60points.meaning: causal 60-point TE8353 trend; 60 points span 59 ten-second intervals

G1_main_flow_command_proxy.meaning: G1 main-line conductance/pressure-drive proxy, not measured mass flow

G2_main_flow_command_proxy.meaning: G2 main-line conductance/pressure-drive proxy, not measured mass flow

A_to_postmix_thermal_drive_proxy.meaning: A-branch command gated by its nominal source/postmix temperature drive

PostMix_specific_cooling_300K_ref_J_kg.meaning: postmix helium specific cooling content relative to a 300 K reference

PostMix_cooling_rate_300K_ref_W.meaning: flow-weighted postmix cooling proxy, not rated refrigerator capacity

Mainline_dT_8351_8352.meaning: measured temperature contrast on the first main-line section

Mainline_dT_8352_8353.meaning: measured temperature contrast on the second main-line section

Mainline_dP_8351_8352_bar.meaning: measured main-line pressure contrast in bar

Module_flow_temperature_drive_proxy.meaning: flow/temperature-drive proxy in g*K/s; not thermal power

Module_dT_Thv_TE8310.meaning: temperature contrast used by the equipment state machine

EC_V2_diff_1.formula: EC-V2[t]-EC-V2[t-1] within an available contiguous sequence
EC_V2_diff_1.meaning: latest EC-V2 action; unavailable values remain missing

COOLDOWN_diff_1.formula: COOLDOWN[t]-COOLDOWN[t-1] within an available contiguous sequence
COOLDOWN_diff_1.meaning: latest COOLDOWN action; Cooldowm is accepted as a source alias

Mainline_apparent_heat_leak_8352_8353_W.meaning: optional downstream apparent enthalpy-gain proxy using PT8352

valve_event_mask.formula: 1 when any available primary valve changes more than the threshold
valve_event_mask.meaning: dynamic-test selector only; never a default model input

feature_catalog.module_valve_missing_policy: never fill missing EC-V2/COOLDOWN with zero; use availability masks and apply the same eligible-parent subset to every model in a module-valve ablation

not_materialized.G_screen_diversion_fraction: removed by the approved feature plan
not_materialized.future_valve_trajectory: belongs to a later MPC dataset, not this forecasting dataset
not_materialized.train_fitted_statistics: scalers/selection/PCA/thresholds must be learned from training only
